tasks.analysis: Cosmology is the study of how the universe began, changed over time, and might evolve in the future. Scientists examine stars, planets, and galaxies using observations and models to describe cosmic events. One widely accepted idea is the big bang, which suggests the universe started from a single point and has been expanding ever since.
